what_worked: Underrated/overhyped tables on slide 8 and revenue-per-visitor analysis are genuinely decision-useful framings.
fix_next: Reconcile total revenue ($15.6M actual vs $334M claimed) and top-10 share (49.6% vs 61%) before any other revision.
verdict: Strong structure and visuals undermined by ~20× revenue inflation and fabricated category rankings.
factual_error_detail: Slide 1: total revenue $334M vs actual $15.6M (~20× inflated). Slide 1: top-10 share 61% vs actual 49.6%. Slide 3: E-comm shown as #1 total revenue ($54.8M) but actual total is $1.1M and AI is #1 ($2.36M); all six category totals on left chart are fabricated at ~20× scale. Slide 3: average MRR figures cannot be verified and appear inflated. Slide 4: 61% concentration repeated. Slide 6: US ~70% of revenue claim unverifiable and likely wrong given actual US Stripe share. Slide 8: key insight mentions Bookedin but Bookedin does not appear in the table shown.

evidence.insight: Slides 7-8 revenue-per-visitor and underrated/overhyped framing show genuine analytical creativity. Slide 4 outlier-trimming discussion demonstrates awareness of skew. However, the central E-comm-leads-on-efficiency thesis (slide 3) is built on fabricated numbers, undermining the headline insight.
evidence.narrative: Clear three-question structure (slide 2) with consistent section headers, key-insight boxes on every content slide, and a six-point synthesis closing (slide 9). Performance→positioning→acquisition flow is logical and purposeful.
evidence.framing: Slide 2 sets up questions clearly. No mention of substantial missingness (274 missing categories, 241 missing countries, 288 missing audience_type, 216 zero-revenue rows) which materially affects every analysis. No limitations or methodology slide. 'Personal reading notes' framing is functional but obscures audience.
evidence.accuracy: Total revenue inflated ~20× ($334M vs $15.6M). Top-10 concentration stated as 61% vs actual 49.6%. Category revenue rankings on slide 3 are wrong (AI is #1 at $2.36M, not E-comm). All six category totals on slide 3 left chart are fabricated at inflated scale. Slide 8 key insight references Bookedin which is absent from the displayed table. Some figures are correct: AI count 197, follower correlation 0.23.
evidence.visual: Consistent navy/gold palette, clean horizontal bar charts with direct labels, appropriate chart types throughout. Tables on slide 8 are well-structured. Slight density on slide 4 with four sub-charts but still readable. No chartjunk or decorative elements.
evidence.ai_slop: Minimal — no stock imagery or generic filler. Template is polished but content-specific. Some consulting-speak ('measurably costing revenue') but not pervasive.
